disposition.why_not_retired: The current origin/main team workflow enforces write scope with `git status --porcelain -uall` over product/, tests/product/, results/product/, reports/product/, state/product.json and data/product/. Deleting or git-mv-ing a committed results/audit/ or reports/audit/ path shows up as a pending out-of-scope change, so the team job would exit 3 and the workflow would never run the independent audit (`if: needs.team.result == 'success'`). Byte-exact retirement was done in cycle 40168184617 for files that entered through a failed producer snapshot; that escape hatch does not apply to an already-committed tree under the current guard.
